english.title: Attempt to make false statement / supply document / info to obtain licence re animals / plants / intro of new species
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) for the purposes of obtaining

(A)_[for yourself,]_
(B)_[another person, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..),]_

the grant of a licence under regulation 55 of the Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations 2017, attempted to

(C)_[make a statement or representation]_
(D)_[supply a document or information]_

which you knew to be false in a material particular
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 59 and 122(1) and (3)(b) of the Conservation of Habitats Regulations 2017.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
for the purposes of obtaining for yourself/another person
the grant of a licence under regulation 55
attempted to make a statement/representation which you knew to be OR
attempted to supply a document/information which you knew to be
false in a material particular

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.standardstatementoffacts:

(F)_[supply a document or information which she knew to be]_
